metadata.description: Pocketcall: leave the computer working and take the phone, without finding out in town that it never started.

plugins.name: pocketcall
plugins.description: Seven silent reasons an evening away never works, checked before you leave; the four minutes at the door and the thirty seconds you repeat every time; how to answer a person who is reading on a phone; and, on a work account, the built-in remote, a cloud session, SSH and tmux, or the company's own relay with an end-to-end encrypted approval card on the phone and in Telegram - whichever the company allows; and a voice note that becomes a task, a pull request and a Yes from the phone while the laptop sleeps. In five languages.
